lastResponse.text: This is life-threatening. Call nine one one right now. Say: “Possible overdose, slow gurgling breathing, not responsive, in Salem.” If you have naloxone, give it now. Keep him on his side, clear his mouth, and stay with him. If he stops breathing, start rescue breaths if you can. Call nine one one now.
originalTexts: This is life-threatening. Call **911 right now**. Say: “Possible overdose, slow gurgling breathing, not responsive, in Salem.” If you have naloxone, give it now. Keep him on his side, clear his mouth, and stay with him. If he stops breathing, start rescue breaths if you can. Call 911 now.
